# Record of processing activities

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:privacy` from packages/shared/src/subprocessors.ts and the settings
     catalog defaults. Do not edit. -->

GDPR Art. 30(2): the processor's record. Figures are the platform defaults; a tenant may set a
shorter retention. Draft for the controller and counsel to confirm.

## Interviews

- **Purpose:** Collecting how work is done, in the participant's words, for the organization that invited them
- **Data subjects:** Participants invited by a customer organization
- **Categories of personal data:**
  - Answers and the conversation transcript
  - Fields the participant enters (name, role, department, email) as the interview template asks
  - Consent record: version and time
  - Files and voice recordings they attach
- **Recipients:** The organization's administrators (by role and privacy mode); the sub-processors in SUBPROCESSORS.md
- **Retention:** 24 months after the interview ends, then deleted; voice recordings after 365 days unless a tenant sets otherwise; the participant may delete at any time
- **Security measures:** Tenant isolation by row-level security, encryption at rest for secrets, TLS in transit, access by role, audit log

## Analysis

- **Purpose:** Combining many interviews into themes and ranked opportunities
- **Data subjects:** Participants of one campaign
- **Categories of personal data:**
  - Facts extracted from answers
  - Short quotes, shown only where at least 3 people support a theme
- **Recipients:** The organization's administrators
- **Retention:** With the campaign; quotes are replaced with a marker when a participant deletes their data
- **Security measures:** Evidence below the anonymity threshold is withheld; reports are role-gated

## Staff accounts

- **Purpose:** Letting an organization's staff run campaigns and read results
- **Data subjects:** Staff of customer organizations and the platform operator
- **Categories of personal data:**
  - Email address, name, role
  - Audit log of administrative actions
- **Recipients:** The organization's administrators; the platform operator
- **Retention:** While the account exists; audit log is append-only and kept with the organization
- **Security measures:** Magic-link or Google sign-in, immediate disable and delete, hash-chained audit log

## Operations

- **Purpose:** Running, securing and billing the service
- **Data subjects:** All of the above
- **Categories of personal data:**
  - Request logs without answer content
  - Model usage and cost ledger by session id
- **Recipients:** The platform operator
- **Retention:** Logs are rotated by the host; the ledger follows the session
- **Security measures:** Logs carry no answer content; ledger holds counts and costs only

## Transfers

See [SUBPROCESSORS.md](SUBPROCESSORS.md) for each provider's location and transfer mechanism.
